chip.description: 'MIE' MAPLE-JVS bridge: Z80-based microcontroller with a 2 KB internal mask ROM and integrated peripherals; fitted on Sega's NAOMI-era JVS I/O boards.
chip.notes: Identification from MAME src/mame/sega/mie.cpp ('MIE aka Sega 315-6146, MAPLE-JVS bridge Z80-based MCU'), whose device_rom_region loads the 315-6146 internal mask ROM. TB2: it normally runs from its on-die ROM, so mcu — one board (837-13844) feeding it external code does not change that.
